title: Minami-ke Season 5 Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, April 2027 Premiere
content: The previously announced Minami-ke Season 5 revealed a teaser visual and trailer along with an April 2027 premiere date. Studio LIDENFILMS is animating. Junichi Kitamura is directing the anime with Takamitsu Kono in charge of the series composition.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Minami-ke Korekara' Reveals New Staff, Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content: • The Minami-ke Special Event 2026 revealed new staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the Season 5 on Sunday. The fifth season adapting Coharu Sakuraba 's comedy slice of life manga will premiere in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Minami-ke Korekara TV Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, Staff, April Debut
content: The " Minami-ke Special Event 2026" debuted the teaser promotional video, teaser visual, and character visuals for Minami-ke: Korekara ( Minami-ke : Going Forward), the new sequel television anime series based on Coharu Sakuraba 's Minami-ke manga , on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Harajuku Himegoto House Multimedia Project Announced
content: Animate announced on Saturday a new multimedia project titled Harajuku Himegoto House , which will include a television anime, music, and more. title: 3 Most Powerful Dragon Ball Techniques That No One Can Win Against
content: Even several years after its debut, the legacy of Dragon Ball can’t be matched by any other anime or manga series. As a battle Shonen, the series has introduced several iconic techniques that add to the thrill of the story.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Upcoming Comedy Anime Set to Make Winter 2027 Hilarious
content: 2027 is just around the corner, and with the new year comes a fresh lineup of anime . Almost every season this year has stood out in its own way, and it seems the next year is set to do the same. However, Winter 2027 is shaping up to be a particularly hilarious season.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s One Piece Zoro Star Reveals He Spent 3 Years Preparing for an Anime Role Other Than Zoro
content: Netflix’s One Piece Zoro star Mackenyu apparently built his body for a new anime role over the past three years. The Japanese actor has made a name for himself in anime live-action adaptations over the years by embodying several different roles.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball’s Mid-Card Fighters Deserve More Screen Time
content: The start of the Dragon Ball universe didn’t always feature power levels well out of the stratosphere, and in fact, the entire first original anime introduced fighters like Tien, Krillin, Master Roshi and more . Then the Super Saiyan power-up was introduced, and everyone quickly forgot this group of normal fighters.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling Studio’s Next Big Anime Confirms Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: Now that 2026 is approaching its end, the anime industry is getting ready for its upcoming releases for 2027, including a gorgeous anime from A-1 Pictures. This is the same studio behind Solo Leveling , and it’s known for several acclaimed shows.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Producers Debunk Major Timeskip Theory
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has officially brought its first season to an end with Paramount+ , and the producers behind it all have unfortunately shut down any hopes of a big time skip coming anytime soon.
